description.zh:
资源组显示名称，用于查询的过滤条件。支持模糊查询。

长度不能超过50个字符。
description.en:
The display name of the resource group. This parameter specifies a filter condition for the query. Fuzzy search is supported.

The display name can be a maximum of 50 characters in length.

description.zh:
是否返回标签信息。取值：

- false（默认值）：不返回。

- true：返回。
> 当您设置了标签过滤条件后，不论`IncludeTags`为何值，都会返回标签信息。
description.en:
Specifies whether to return the information of tags. Valid values:

*   false (default)
*   true

>  If you set a tag filter condition, the tag information is returned regardless of the `IncludeTags` value.

description.zh:
资源组唯一标识，用于查询的过滤条件。支持模糊查询。

长度不能超过50个字符，可包含英文字母、数字和短划线（-）。
description.en:
The identifier of the resource group. This parameter specifies a filter condition for the query. Fuzzy search is supported.

The identifier can be a maximum of 50 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, and hyphens (-).
The page number of the returned page.

description.zh: 分页时每页显示的数据条数。
description.en: The number of entries returned per page.
The IDs of the resource groups that you want to query.
The ID of the region where the resource resides.

description.zh:
资源组状态，用于查询的过滤条件。取值：

- Creating：创建中。
- OK：创建成功。
- PendingDelete：等待删除。
description.en:
The status of the resource group. This parameter specifies a filter condition for the query. Valid values:

*   Creating: The resource group is being created.
*   OK: The resource group is created.
*   PendingDelete: The resource group is waiting to be deleted.

title.zh: 列出资源组与用户授权信息

example.unifiedCli: aliyun resourcemanager list-resource-groups-with-auth-details --status OK --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --display-name TestRG-BVT1 --name prod-rg --tag Value=v1 Key=k1 --include-tags true --resource-group-ids rg-acfm3uwewyefzuy --resource-types ResourceTypeCode=instance Service=ecs --resource-region-id cn-shenzhen --api-version 2020-03-31 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun resourcemanager ListResourceGroupsWithAuthDetails --region cn-hangzhou --Status OK --IncludeTags true --Tag.1.Key k1 --ResourceRegionId 'cn-shenzhen' --ResourceTypes.1.Service ecs --PageSize 10 --PageNumber 1 --Tag.1.Value v1 --ResourceGroupIds.1 'rg-acfm3uwewyefzuy' --DisplayName 'TestRG-BVT1' --ResourceTypes.1.ResourceTypeCode instance --Name 'prod-rg' --method POST --force
